content.json:
# Coffee shop assistant
Volume, routes, latency, cost, safety and errors of the deployed API. Every number comes from OpenTelemetry (`src/api/app/telemetry.py`); question texts are never in telemetry (NFR11): follow a `conversation_id` to Cosmos to read one.

content.query:
let cost_usd = toscalar(AppMetrics | where Name == 'chat.cost.usd' | summarize round(sum(Sum), 4));
AppDependencies | where Name == 'chat.turn'
| extend allowed = tolower(tostring(Properties['guard.allowed'])), conversation = tostring(Properties['conversation_id'])
| summarize turns = sum(ItemCount), conversations = dcount(conversation), p50_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 50),
    p95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95), blocked = sumif(ItemCount, allowed == 'false')
| extend block_rate_pct = round(100.0 * blocked / turns, 1), cost_usd = cost_usd,
    cost_per_conversation_usd = round(cost_usd / conversations, 5)
| project turns, conversations, p50_ms, p95_ms, block_rate_pct, cost_usd, cost_per_conversation_usd
content.title: Overview

content.query: AppDependencies | where Name == 'chat.turn' | extend agent = tostring(Properties['chat.agent']), allowed = tolower(tostring(Properties['guard.allowed'])), conversation = tostring(Properties['conversation_id']) | summarize turns = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), agent
content.title: Turns per agent

content.query: AppDependencies | where Name == 'chat.turn' | extend agent = tostring(Properties['chat.agent']), allowed = tolower(tostring(Properties['guard.allowed'])), conversation = tostring(Properties['conversation_id']) | summarize turns = sum(ItemCount) by agent
content.title: Routes

content.query: AppDependencies | where Name == 'chat.turn' | extend agent = tostring(Properties['chat.agent']), allowed = tolower(tostring(Properties['guard.allowed'])), conversation = tostring(Properties['conversation_id']) | summarize turns = sum(ItemCount), p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by agent | order by p95 desc
content.title: Latency per agent (ms)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where Name in ('guard', 'content_safety', 'router', 'search.query') or Name startswith 'agent ' or Name startswith 'chat gpt' or Name startswith 'embeddings'
| summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), calls = sum(ItemCount) by step = Name
| order by p95 desc
content.title: Where a turn spends its time (p95, ms)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name == 'chat.cost.usd' | summarize cost = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m) | order by TimeGenerated asc | extend cumulative_usd = row_cumsum(cost) | project TimeGenerated, cumulative_usd
content.title: Cumulative model cost (USD)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name == 'chat.tokens' | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), type = tostring(Properties['type'])
content.title: Tokens by type

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name == 'guard.blocked' | summarize blocks = sum(Sum) by layer = tostring(Properties['layer']), reason = tostring(Properties['reason'])
content.title: Guard blocks by layer

content.query: AppRequests | where Name startswith 'POST /api' or Name startswith 'GET /api' | summarize requests = sum(ItemCount), errors_5xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: HTTP errors (5xx) and requests

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where Name == 'search.query' and tolower(tostring(Properties['search.abstained'])) == 'true'
| project TimeGenerated, conversation_id = tostring(Properties['conversation_id']),
    best_reranker_score = todouble(Properties['search.best_reranker_score'])
| order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50
content.title: Questions with no relevant document (read them in Cosmos by conversation id)

content.query: AppMetrics | where Name == 'order.total.mismatch' | summarize mismatches = sum(Sum) | extend mismatches = coalesce(mismatches, 0.0)
content.title: Order total mismatches (must stay at 0)
